title: Israel’s ‘pilot zones’: Withdrawal on paper, continued occupation of south Lebanon
english: A new agreement involving Israel, the U.S., and Lebanon has established 'pilot zones' in three southern Lebanese villages to facilitate a gradual Israeli troop withdrawal. The plan requires the Lebanese Army to take control of these areas while ensuring Hezbollah militants are removed from the locations. Although framed as a step toward sovereignty, critics argue that these zones effectively maintain an ongoing Israeli presence in the region.
amharic: እስራኤል፣ አሜሪካ እና ሊባኖስ በደቡብ ሊባኖስ የሚገኙ ሶስት መንደሮችን እንደ 'ሙከራ ዞኖች' ለመሰየም ስምምነት ላይ ደርሰዋል። ይህ እቅድ የእስራኤል ጦር ቀስ በቀስ ለቆ እንዲወጣ እና የሊባኖስ ጦር ስልጣኑን እንዲረከብ እንዲሁም የሂዝቦላህ ታጣቂዎች ከነዚህ አካባቢዎች እንዲወጡ ለማድረግ ያለመ ነው። ይሁን እንጂ ስምምነቱ በወረቀት ላይ ቢሆንም፣ የሊባኖስ አካባቢዎች አሁንም በተግባር በእስራኤል ቁጥጥር ስር መሆናቸው እየተነገረ ነው።
oromo: Israa'el, Ameerikaafi Libaanoos, gandaalee kibba Libaanoos keessa jiran saditti 'naannolee qorannoo' dhaabuuf walii galtee irra ga'aniiru. Karoorri kun waraanni Israa'el gadi lakkisee akka ba'uufi aangoon gara waraana Libaanoositti akka darbu, akkasumas gareen Hizbollaah naannolee sana keessaa akka ba'an taasisuuf kan qophaaye dha. Haa ta'u malee, qajeelfamni kun waraqaa irratti malee, dhugaa irratti Israa'el ammallee naannolee kana to'achaa jirti kan jedhu komiin jira.

title: Sedition to anthem: Many lives of ‘Azadi’ chants in India’s youth protests
english: The 'Azadi' slogan, which means freedom, has resurfaced as a powerful anthem for Indian students protesting against Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government. Recently, these chants became a symbol of resistance during demonstrations following a major exam leak scandal that led to the Education Minister's resignation. While the phrase was once criminalized and associated with treason charges against student leaders a decade ago, it has now transformed into a mainstream rallying cry for youth activism across several Indian cities.
amharic: ነጻነትን የሚገልጸው 'አዛዲ' የሚለው መፈክር በህንድ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናሬንድራ ሞዲ መንግስት ላይ በሚደረጉ የተማሪዎች የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች ላይ እንደገና ዋና መዝሙር ሆኖ ብቅ ብሏል። በቅርቡ በትምህርት ሚኒስትሩ መልቀቅ ምክንያት በሆነው የፈተና መሰረቅ ቅሌት ተከትሎ በተደረጉ ተቃውሞዎች ላይ ይህ መፈክር የትግሉ ምልክት ሆኗል። ከዚህ በፊት ከአስር አመት በፊት ይህ መፈክር እንደ ወንጀል ይታይ እና ተማሪዎችን ለከፍተኛ ችግር ይዳርግ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት ግን በህንድ ከተሞች በስፋት የሚሰማ የወጣቶች የትግል ድምፅ ሆኗል።
oromo: Jechi 'Azadi' jedhu kan hiikni isaa bilisummaa ta'e, mormii barattoonni mootummaa Indiyaa kan Ministira Muummee Narendra Modi irratti godhaniif akka faaruu fi mallattoo guddaatti deebi'ee qabateera. Dhiheenya kana, qormaata biyyoolessaa waliin walqabatee rakkoo uumameen Ministirri Barnootaa aangoo gadi lakkisuun isaa mormii cimaa uumee, achirrattis jechi kun sagalee guddaa ta'eera. Waggaa kudhan dura jechi kun akka yakkaatti ilaalamaa fi hogganoota barattootaa irratti himannaa gurguddaa fidaa kan ture ta'us, har'a garuu guddinaa fi sagalee mormii dargaggootaa kan biyyattii ta'ee jira.

title: How blind football is helping women overcome barriers in Mexico
english: Mexico is set to participate in an international blind women's football tournament for the first time, represented by the Chilangas FC team. Players use a sound-emitting ball and verbal cues to navigate the pitch, breaking down societal barriers for visually impaired athletes. The team was formed after Coach Wendy del Rio noticed a lack of opportunities for women who wanted to play the sport, and she hopes their historic participation will inspire more women to join.
amharic: ሜክሲኮ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በዓለም አቀፍ የዓይነ ስውራን ሴቶች እግር ኳስ ውድድር ላይ በቺላንጋስ ኤፍሲ ቡድን አማካኝነት ለመሳተፍ ተዘጋጅታለች። ተጫዋቾቹ ድምፅ በሚያሰማ ኳስ እና በአሰልጣኞች መመሪያ በመታገዝ ይጫወታሉ፣ ይህ ደግሞ ለአካል ጉዳተኛ ሴቶች ያለውን ማህበራዊ መሰናክል ለመስበር ይረዳል። ቡድኑ የተቋቋመው አሰልጣኝ ወንዲ ዴል ሪዮ ለእግር ኳስ ፍላጎት ያላቸው ሴቶች በቂ እድል እንደሌላቸው በመገንዘቧ ሲሆን፣ ይህ ታሪካዊ ተሳትፎ ሌሎች ሴቶችንም ወደ ስፖርቱ እንዲመጡ ያነሳሳቸዋል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Meksiikoon yeroo jalqabaaf gartuu 'Chilangas FC' jedhamuun dorgommii kubbaa miilaa dubartoota ija hin qabnee kan idil-addunyaa irratti hirmaachuuf qophoofteetti. Taphattoonni kun kubbaa sagalee qabuufi qajeelfama gartuusaanii irraa argatan fayyadamuun taphatu; kunis dubartoota miidhaan qaamaa irra ga'eef gufuu hawaasummaa cabsuuf gargaara. Gartuun kun kan hundaa'e erga leenjistuu Wendy del Rio dubartoonni taphachuu barbaadan carraa akka hin qabne hubattee booda yoo ta'u, hirmaannaan isaanii kun dubartoota biroo hedduu gara ispoortii kanaatti akka dhufan kan kakaasu ta'a.

title: Israel’s ‘pilot zones’: Withdrawal on paper, continued occupation of south Lebanon
english: Under a 2026 agreement, three southern Lebanese villages have been established as 'pilot zones' intended to facilitate an Israeli withdrawal and restore Lebanese military control. However, analysts and observers report that Israel is using these areas to maintain its occupation rather than leaving, as evidenced by continued military attacks and destruction in nearby sectors. This situation highlights a significant gap between the formal agreement and the reality on the ground, where Israeli forces remain active despite the declared transition.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ2026 በተደረገ ስምምነት መሠረት፣ የእስራኤልን ጦር መውጣት እና የሊባኖስን ጦር ቁጥጥር ለማመቻቸት ሶስት የደቡብ ሊባኖስ መንደሮች እንደ 'ሙከራ ዞኖች' ተወስነዋል። ይሁን እንጂ ተንታኞች እንደሚጠቁሙት እስራኤል እነዚህን አካባቢዎች የምትጠቀምባቸው ከጦርነት ለመውጣት ሳይሆን መሬቱን በቁጥጥሯ ስር ለማቆየት ነው። በአቅራቢያው በሚገኙ አካባቢዎች የሚካሄደው ቀጣይ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት እና ውድመት፣ በስምምነቱ ወረቀት ላይ ካለው እቅድ እና በተግባር ካለው እውነታ መካከል ያለውን ሰፊ ክፍተት ያሳያል።
oromo: waliigaltee bara 2026 irraa ka’uun, baadiyoonni Kibba Libnaan sadii akka 'naannoo qormaataa' ykn 'pilot zones' kanneen humnoonni Israa'el itti bahanii fi mootummaan Libnaan to'annoo isaa itti deebisuuf yaadaman hundaa'aniiru. Ta'us, ogeeyyonni akka ibsanitti, Israa'el naannolee kana kan itti fayyadamaa jirtuufi bahuuf osoo hin taane, to'annoo ishee itti fufuuf ta'uun ni mirkanaa'a. Qarqara naannolee kanneenitti weerarri waraanaa fi diigumsi ammayyuu itti fufaa jiraachuun isaa, walii galtee barreeffamaa fi haala qabatamaa jiru gidduutti garagarummaa guddaa akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: Israeli strikes kill 11 in southern Lebanon, Lebanese health ministry says​
english: Israeli military strikes in southern Lebanon have resulted in the deaths of at least 11 people and left 19 others injured. The attacks targeted residential areas in the towns of Ansar and Deir al-Zahrani. This incident marks a significant escalation in violence shortly after a U.S.-brokered peace agreement was established.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ 11 ሰዎች ሲገደሉ 19 ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ ያነጣጠረው በአንሳር እና በዴየር አል-ዛህራኒ ከተሞች በሚገኙ መኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ነው። ይህ ድርጊት በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት የሰላም ስምምነት ከተደረገ በኋላ የተከሰተ ከፍተኛ የኃይል መባባስ ነው።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'eel kibba Libanonirratti haleellaa geggeesseen namoonni 11 ol du'aniiru, 19 immoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame magaalaawwan Ansaar fi Deeyar al-Zahraanii keessatti mana jireenyaarratti ta'uu gabaasameera. Haleellaan kun marii nagaa Ameerikaan giddu galeessa taatee gaggeessite booda kan uumame yoo ta'u, rakkoo naannichaa kan hammeesse dha.

title: How Iran and Ukraine are strategically sinking their rivals at sea
english: Despite significant military pressure and airstrikes from the US and Israel, Iran has maintained its strategic resilience by utilizing its maritime capabilities to control key shipping routes. By threatening global energy markets through the Strait of Hormuz, Iran has successfully countered foreign military dominance and turned its naval leverage into bargaining power. This strategy highlights how controlling the seas allows a nation to withstand aerial attacks and force adversaries into diplomatic negotiations rather than achieving total military victory.
amharic: ምንም እንኳን አሜሪካ እና እስራኤል ከፍተኛ የአየር ጥቃት ቢሰነዝሩም፣ ኢራን በባህር ላይ ባላት ቁጥጥር እና የስትራቴጂክ ማቋረጫ መስመሮችን በመቆጣጠር ሉዓላዊነቷን ማስጠበቅ ችላለች። የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን በመጠቀም በዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ገበያ ላይ ተጽዕኖ ማሳደሯ፣ የአየር ጥቃቶችን በመቋቋም ተቃዋሚዎቿን ወደ ድርድር ጠረጴዛ እንድትመጣ አስችሏታል። ይህ ሁኔታ ሀገራት በባህር ላይ ያላቸው አቅም በአየር ላይ ከሚደርስ ጥቃት ለመከላከል እና ለፖለቲካዊ ጥቅም ለመጠቀም እንደሚያስችላቸው ያሳያል።
oromo: Amerikaa fi Israa'el miidhaa qilleensaa cimaa ishee irratti gaggeessan iyyuu, Iraan dandeettii galaana ishee fi daandiiwwan daldala galaana ijoo to'achuudhaan of-danda'uu ishee itti fufteetti. Daandii Hormuz to'achuudhaan gabaa anniisaa addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa gochuun, Iraan weerara qilleensaa of irraa ittisuu fi diinota ishee gara mariitti fidachuuf gargaareera. Karoorri kun, aangoon galaana irraa biyyoonni tokko weerara qilleensaa dandamatanii fi humni isaan galaana irraa qaban akka meeshaa marii fi dhimma siyaasaatti fayyadamuu akka danda'an agarsiisa.

title: Lebanese parliament speaker condemns Israeli 'massacre'
english: Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon have resulted in at least 11 deaths and 19 injuries. Lebanese parliamentary leader Nabih Berri strongly condemned the violence, labeling the offensive a massacre intended to destroy the population. Meanwhile, Hezbollah officials accused the Israeli government of escalating the conflict to gain political advantages and appease hardline supporters.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ 11 ሰዎች ሲገደሉ 19 ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። የሊባኖስ ፓርላማ አፈ-ጉባኤ ናቢህ ቤሪ ጥቃቱን የጅምላ ጭፍጨፋ ሲሉ አውግዘውታል። ሂዝቦላህ በበኩሉ እስራኤል የራሷን የፖለቲካ ፍላጎት ለማሳካት ሆን ብላ ጦርነቱን እያባባሰች ነው ሲል ከሷል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'eel kibba Libaanoos irratti qilleensaan haleellaa raawwateen namoonni 11 yoo du'an, 19 immoo madaa'aniiru. Afaan-umanii mana maree Libaanoos Naabih Berriin haleellaa kana 'fixiinsa sanyii' jechuun balaaleffataniiru. Gama biraatiin, gareen Hizbullaah, mootummaan Israa'eel faayidaa siyaasaa isaatiif jecha walitti bu'iinsa kana hammaachiisaa jira jechuun himateera.

title: Deadly Israeli strikes kill nine in southern Lebanon as tensions escalate
english: Israeli air strikes in southern Lebanon have resulted in the deaths of at least nine people and caused numerous injuries. The attacks, which hit residential areas including Ansar and Deir al-Zahrani, have prompted Lebanon's Prime Minister to condemn the violence against civilians and reject Israel's claims that these locations were military targets. Meanwhile, Hezbollah has vowed to retaliate, warning that the ongoing regional escalation will not go unanswered.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በተፈጸሙ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃቶች ቢያንስ ዘጠኝ ሰዎች መገደላቸውንና በርካታ ቁስለኞች መኖራቸውን መረጃዎች ያመለክታሉ። ጥቃቱ በአንሳር እና በዴየር አል-ዛህራኒ አካባቢ በሚገኙ መኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ያነጣጠረ ሲሆን፣ የሊባኖስ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጉዳዩን በማውገዝ ኢላማዎቹ ሲቪሎች እንጂ ወታደራዊ ቦታዎች እንዳልሆኑ ገልጸዋል። በበኩሉ ሂዝቦላህ ለደረሰው ጥቃት ተመጣጣኝ ምላሽ እንደሚሰጥ በማስታወቅ ውጥረቱ መባባሱን ገልጿል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el kibba Libanon keessatti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwateen namoonni sagal lubbuun isaanii darbee jiru. Haleellaan kun bakkeewwan namoonni keessa jiraatan Ansar fi Deir al-Zahrani irratti kan xiyyeeffate yoo ta'u, muummeen ministiraa Libanon haleellaa sivilii irratti raawwatame kana balaaleffataniiru. Gamtaan Hizbollaa gama isaatiin, haleellaa kanaaf deebii kan kennan ta'uu ibsuun, walitti bu'iinsi naannicha keessaa daran hammaachaa akka jiru beeksisaniiru.

title: The next Yemen war might be different
english: The conflict in Yemen is evolving as forces aligned with the internationally recognized government have begun utilizing drone warfare against the Houthis. While the Houthis still maintain a significant technological advantage, the government's ability to strike previously secure positions forces the rebel group to alter their tactical operations. Even without reaching full military parity, this shift in tactics represents a significant change in the nature of the ongoing war.
amharic: በየመን ያለው ግጭት በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ እውቅና የተሰጠው መንግሥት ደጋፊ ኃይሎች በሁቲዎች ላይ የድሮን ጥቃቶችን መጠቀም በመጀመራቸው አዲስ መልክ እየያዘ ነው። ምንም እንኳን ሁቲዎች አሁንም የላቀ የቴክኖሎጂ አቅም ቢኖራቸውም፣ የመንግሥት ኃይሎች በጠላት ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸም መቻላቸው የሁቲዎችን የጦርነት ስልት እንዲቀይሩ አስገድዷቸዋል። ይህ ለውጥ ሙሉ በሙሉ ወታደራዊ አቻነት ባይኖርም፣ በጦርነቱ አካሄድ ላይ ትልቅ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Waraanni Yaman keessatti adeemaa jiru jijjiirama ammayyaa argataa jira; kunis humnootiin mootummaa beekamtii argatan, haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) fayyadamuu jalqabuu isaaniitiin kan dhufe dha. Huthonni ammayyuu dandeettiifi teeknoolojii waraanaa guddaa kan qaban ta'us, humnootiin mootummaa bakkeewwan huthonni itti fayyadaman haleeluun isaanii, gareen kun adeemsa waraana isaa akka jijjiiru dirqisiiseera. Jijjiiramni kun humna waraanaa walqixa ta'e uumuu baatus, waraanichi akka kanaan duraa akka hin taane godheera.

title: Afghans mark five years of Taliban rule
english: Afghanistan recently observed the fifth anniversary of the Taliban's return to power, an event marked by ceremonies in Kabul that notably excluded most women. The country continues to face significant international isolation while grappling with a deepening humanitarian crisis. Furthermore, the systematic removal of women from public spaces remains a defining and concerning aspect of the current administration's rule.
amharic: አፍጋኒስታን የታልባን ወደ ስልጣን የተመለሱበትን አምስተኛ ዓመት በማስታወስ በካቡል የክብር ስነስርዓት አከናውነዋል። በስነስርዓቱ ላይ አብዛኛው ሴቶች እንዳይሳተፉ የተደረገ ሲሆን፣ አገሪቱ አሁንም በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ተገልላ በከባድ ሰብዓዊ ቀውስ ውስጥ ትገኛለች። በተጨማሪም ሴቶች ከህዝባዊ ህይወት እየተገለሉ መምጣታቸው የአሁኑ አስተዳደር ዋነኛ መገለጫ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Afgaanistaan waggaa shan guutuu mootummaan Taalibaan aangoo irra jiraachuu isaa yaadatanii jiru. Ayyaanichi magaalaa Kaabulitti kan kabajame yoo ta'u, dubartoonni baay'een isaanii sirnichaa irraa akka hin hirmaanne godhameera. Biyyi kun ammas addunyaa irraa adda baatee kan jirtu yoo ta'u, rakkoon nam-tolchee biyyattii keessatti bal'achaa jiraachuu isaa gabaasameera.

title: Black professor at centre of Cambridge plagiarism row found dead
english: Dr. Jason Arday, a professor at Cambridge University, has passed away shortly after resigning from his position following allegations of plagiarism. His family has publicly denounced the intense media scrutiny he faced, describing the coverage as a targeted misinformation campaign. Reports indicate that over 180 articles were published about the professor within a brief nine-day period.
amharic: የካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ፕሮፌሰር የሆኑት ዶክተር ጄሰን አርዳይ፣ በምርምር ስርቆት ክስ ምክንያት ከሥራቸው እንደለቀቁ ብዙም ሳይቆዩ በድንገት ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይተዋል። ቤተሰቦቻቸው በፕሮፌሰሩ ላይ የተካሄደውን የብዙሃን መገናኛ ዘገባዎች 'የሃሰት መረጃ ዘመቻ' በማለት አውግዘዋል። ባለሙያው በዘጠኝ ቀናት ውስጥ ብቻ ከ180 በላይ የዜና ዘገባዎች መጻፋቸው ጉዳዩን ይበልጥ አወዛጋቢ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Pirofesara Yuunivarsitii Kaambiriij kan ta'an Dr. Jeeson Ardeey, himannaa yakka hatuu qorannoo (plagiarism) irraa ka'uudhaan hojii gadhiisanii guyyoota muraasa booda du'anii argamaniiru. Maatiin isaanii miidiyaaleen irratti xiyyeeffannoo cimaa godhan 'duula odeeffannoo sobaa' akka ta'e ibsuun balaaleeffataniiru. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, guyyoota sagal keessatti qofa pirofesaricha irratti barruuleen 188 ol maxxanfamanii turan.

title: Vienna woman sues city for discrimination over toilet fees
english: A woman living in Vienna has initiated a lawsuit against the city, claiming that public restroom pricing is unfair. She argues that women face discrimination because they are required to pay for toilet stalls, while men are able to use urinals without any charge. The activist is seeking to challenge this disparity in public facility access.
amharic: የቪየና ነዋሪ የሆኑ አንዲት ሴት በከተማው የህዝብ መፀዳጃ ቤት አገልግሎት ክፍያ ላይ አድልዎ አለ በሚል ክስ መስርተዋል። ሴቶች መፀዳጃ ቤት ለመጠቀም ክፍያ ሲከፍሉ ወንዶች ግን ያለ ክፍያ የሽንት ቤት አገልግሎት ማግኘታቸው ተገቢ አይደለም በማለት ጉዳዩን ለፍርድ ቤት አቅርበውታል። ይህ ድርጊት በጾታ መካከል ልዩነት የሚፈጥር በመሆኑ እንዲታረም ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Dubartiin magaalaa Viyeenaa jiraattu tokko, tajaajila mana fincaanii hawaasaa irratti garaagarummaan jiraachuu isaatiin magaalaa sana irratti himata banatteetti. Dubartoonni mana fincaanii fayyadamuuf kaffaltii kan kaffalan yoo ta'u, dhiironni garuu kaffaltii malee itti fayyadamuu danda'uun isaanii jibba fi addaan qooduudha jechuun falmiti. Inni kunis akkaataa tajaajila hawaasaa irratti wal-qixxummaan akka jiraatu gaafatti.

title: Five wounded in shooting at Virginia State University
english: Five people were injured, including one critically, during a shooting incident near residence halls at Virginia State University early Saturday morning. Local authorities initiated a campus-wide lockdown as they searched for multiple suspects, though the order has since been lifted. An investigation is currently underway, and police are urging anyone with relevant information to come forward just days before the start of the fall semester.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ማለዳ በቨርጂኒያ ስቴት ዩኒቨርሲቲ ግቢ ውስጥ በተፈጠረ የተኩስ ልውውጥ አምስት ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል፤ ከነዚህም መካከል የአንዱ ሁኔታ አሳሳቢ ነው። ጥቃቱን ተከትሎ ፖሊስ ግቢውን ዘግቶ ፍተሻ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ ተጠርጣሪዎችን ለማግኘት ምርመራው ቀጥሏል። ተማሪዎች ትምህርት ሊጀምሩ ጥቂት ቀናት ሲቀራቸው በተፈጠረው በዚህ ድርጊት ላይ መረጃ ያላቸው አካላት ለፖሊስ እንዲያሳውቁ ጥሪ ቀርቧል።
oromo: Ganama Sanbata ganama dhaabbata barnoota ol Aanaa Virginia State University jedhamutti dhukaasa halkan kanaan gahe namoota shan irratti miidhaan gaheera; isaan keessaa tokko haalli isaa hamaa dha. Poolisiin shakkamtoota hedduu barbaadaa turee fi wayita ammaa hordoffiin kun itti fufee jira. Barnoonni waggaa haaraa jalqabamuuf guyyoota muraasa hafan kanatti, namoonni waa'ee dhukaasa kanaa beektan poolisiif gumaacha gochuu akka dandeessan dhaamsa dabarsaniiru.

title: Iran accuses French diplomats of 'infiltration'
english: Iranian authorities have formally accused two French diplomats of attempting to infiltrate and interfere in the country's internal affairs. The intelligence ministry claims these individuals were caught at a clandestine location with documents suggesting they were building unauthorized networks. No concrete proof has been presented, and the French government has not yet responded to these allegations.
amharic: የኢራን መንግሥት ሁለት የፈረንሳይ ዲፕሎማቶች በሀገሪቱ የውስጥ ጉዳይ ላይ ጣልቃ በመግባት ሰርጎ ለመግባት ሲሞክሩ እንደነበር ከሰሰ። የኢራን የስለላ ሚኒስቴር እንዳለው ዲፕሎማቶቹ ሚስጥራዊ በሆነ ቦታ ተገኝተዋል እንዲሁም መደበኛ ያልሆነ ግንኙነት ለመፍጠር ሲያሴሩ የሚያሳይ ሰነድ ተገኝቷል። በጉዳዩ ላይ እስካሁን ድረስ ምንም አይነት ተጨባጭ ማስረጃ አልቀረበም እንዲሁም የፈረንሳይ መንግሥትም እስካሁን አስተያየት አልሰጠም።
oromo: Mootummaan Iraan dippilomatoota Faransaay lama biyyattii keessatti sochiin duubatti deebi'anii seenuufi gidduu galuu gaggeessaniiru jechuun himateera. Ministeerri odeeffannoo Iraan akka jedhutti, dippilomatootni kunneen bakka icitii tokkotti qabamanii, ragaa walitti dhufeenya seeraan alaa uumuf yaalii gochaa turan agarsiisu argameera. Himannaa kanaaf ragaan qabatamaan dhiyaate hin jiru, mootummaan Faransaayis hanga ammaatti waan tokko hin jedhe.

title: Israeli drone strike injures three in central Gaza
english: An Israeli drone attack in Deir al-Balah, located in central Gaza, has left three Palestinians wounded. One of the victims is currently in a critical state following the strike. All individuals have been transported to Al-Aqsa hospital to receive medical attention.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ጋዛ ዲር አል-ባላህ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የድሮን ጥቃት ሶስት ፍልስጤማውያን ቆስለዋል። ከተጎጂዎቹ መካከል አንዱ አደገኛ በሆነ ሁኔታ ላይ ይገኛል። ሁሉም ጉዳተኞች ህክምና እንዲያገኙ ወደ አል-አቅሳ ሆስፒታል ተወስደዋል።
oromo: Humni Israa'el magaalaa Deir al-Balah kan giddu gala Gaazaatti argamtu irratti xiyyaara nama malee balali'uun haleellaa raawwateen namoonni sadii miidhamaniiru. Namoota miidhaman keessaa tokko haalli isaa hamaa akka ta'e gabaafameera. Miidhamtoonni hundi yaalamuu fi wal'aansa argachuuf gara hospitaala Al-Aqsa geessamaniiru.

title: Thirteen years after Rabaa massacre, families urge Egypt to free political prisoners
english: On the 13th anniversary of the Rabaa massacre, the Families of Egyptian Detainees Association has called on the government to release individuals imprisoned following the 2013 crackdown. The group argues that these protesters were unfairly turned into defendants after the violent dispersal of sit-ins that left at least 900 people dead. They are advocating for national reconciliation and the enforcement of constitutional provisions regarding transitional justice to address the ongoing detention of thousands of political prisoners.
amharic: የራባ ጭፍጨፋ ከተፈጸመ 13 ዓመታት በኋላ፣ የግብጽ እስረኞች ቤተሰቦች ማህበር መንግስት ከ2013ቱ የኃይል እርምጃ ጋር በተያያዘ የታሰሩ ሰዎችን እንዲለቅ ጠይቋል። ቡድኑ ቢያንስ 900 ሰዎች በተገደሉበት ወቅት ተቃዋሚዎች ከሰላማዊ ሰልፈኞች ወደ ተከሳሽነት መቀየራቸውን ገልጿል። ቤተሰቦቹ የሽግግር ፍትህን ተግባራዊ በማድረግ እና ብሔራዊ እርቅን በማምጣት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የፖለቲካ እስረኞች በአስቸኳይ እንዲፈቱ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Humni ajjeechaa Rabaa waggaa 13 dura raawwatamee booda, Waldaan Maatii Hidhamtoota Gibxii mootummaan namoota bara 2013 erga hiriira sana booda hidhaman akka gadhiisu gaafate. Gareen kun, namoonni nageenyaan mormii dhageessisaa turan hiriirichi humnaan diigamee namoonni 900 ol ajjeefamanii booda, akka yakka hojjetanitti qabamuun isaanii sirrii akka hin taane ibsaniiru. Maatiin hidhamtootaa kun, biyyattiin gara araaga biyyaalessaatti akka deemtuuf fi seerota jijjiiramaa hojii irra oolchuun hidhamtoota siyaasaa kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman akka gadhiiftu gaafataniiru.

title: Oxygen stations operating beyond capacity in Gaza
english: Gaza's healthcare system is facing a critical emergency as oxygen production facilities are severely overwhelmed. Due to restrictions on essential supplies entering the region, a large majority of oxygen stations and cylinders are no longer working. Officials emphasize that oxygen is a life-saving necessity, and its current shortage poses a grave threat to patients in critical care.
amharic: የጋዛ የጤና አገልግሎት ኦክሲጅን ማምረቻ ጣቢያዎች አቅማቸው በላይ በመሥራታቸው ለከባድ ቀውስ ተጋልጧል። ወደ ክልሉ አስፈላጊ የሕክምና ቁሳቁሶች እንዳይገቡ በመከልከሉ አብዛኛዎቹ የኦክሲጅን ጣቢያዎችና ሲሊንደሮች አገልግሎት መስጠት አቁመዋል። የጤና ሚኒስቴር እንደገለጸው ኦክሲጅን ለታካሚዎች ሕይወት አድን በመሆኑ፣ አሁን ያለው እጥረት በሕክምና ክፍሎች ውስጥ ትልቅ የሞት አደጋን ደቅኗል።
oromo: Hospitaalonni Gaazaatti argaman bu’uuraalee oksijiinii gahaa dhabuu isaaniitiin rakkoo cimaa keessa jiru. Itti fayyadamni oksijiinii daangaa isaa darbee kan jiru yoo ta’u, meeshaaleen barbaachisaa ta’an gara naannichaa akka hin seenne dhorkamuun isaanii dhaabbilee oksijiinii hedduu hojiin ala godheera. Ministirri fayyaa akka ibsetti, oksijiiniin lubbuu oolchuuf murteessaa waan ta’eef, hanqinni kun dhukkubsattoota iddoo yaala cimaa jiraniif balaa guddaa dha.

title: Israeli attacks kill nine people in southern Lebanon
english: Israeli military airstrikes in southern Lebanon have resulted in the deaths of nine people and left several others injured. The casualties occurred during separate attacks on the villages of Deir ez-Zahrani and Ansar. The Israeli military has officially acknowledged carrying out these recent operations in the region.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ድብደባ ዘጠኝ ሰዎች ሲገደሉ በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቶቹ የተፈጸሙት በዴየር ኤዝ-ዛህራኒ እና በአንሳር መንደሮች ላይ ነው። የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በክልሉ ጥቃት መፈጸሙን አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el kibba Libaanoositti qilleensa irraa haleellaa geggeesseen namoonni sagal lubbuun dabraniru, kan biroos miidhamaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame baadiyyaa Deir ez-Zahrani fi Ansar keessatti. Humni waraana Israa'el bakkeewwan kanneenitti haleellaa geggeessuu isaa mirkaneesseera.

title: Five years on, how will Taliban deal with armed opposition?
english: Five years after regaining power, the Taliban continues to face various armed opposition groups across Afghanistan. While the United Nations confirms these groups remain active, they have failed to seize territory or pose a significant threat to Taliban control. Experts suggest these factions struggle to gain influence because they are often fragmented, poorly coordinated, and frequently operate from outside the country.
amharic: ታሊባን ወደ ስልጣን ከተመለሰ አምስት ዓመታት ያለፈው ሲሆን፣ አሁንም በአፍጋኒስታን ውስጥ በተለያዩ የታጠቁ ተቃዋሚ ቡድኖች እየተፈታተኑ ይገኛል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እነዚህ ቡድኖች አሁንም ንቁ እንደሆኑ ቢገልጽም፣ በታሊባን ቁጥጥር ስር ባሉ አካባቢዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ መፍጠር አልቻሉም። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት፣ እነዚህ ቡድኖች በሀገር ውስጥ ጠንካራ መሰረት የሌላቸው፣ የተከፋፈሉ እና ብዙ ጊዜ ከውጭ የሚንቀሳቀሱ በመሆናቸው ለታሊባን ትልቅ ስጋት ሊሆኑ አልቻሉም።
oromo: Talibaan gara aangoo erga deebi'ee waggoota shan erga darbee booda, ammas Afgaanistaan keessatti garee mormituu hidhatee jiru garagaraa mudachaa jira. Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii gareewwan kun ammas akka jiran mirkaneessus, lafa to’achuuf ykn bulchiinsa Talibaan irratti balaa guddaa uumuu hin dandeenye. Hayyoonni akka ibsanitti, gareewwan kun bakka bittinnaa’anii jiraniifi irra caalaan isaanii biyya alaatii waan socho’aniif, biyyattii keessatti hirmaannaa fi fudhatama guddaa argachuu hin dandeenye.

title: Afghan refugees face an uncertain future as Europe shifts to the right
english: Many Afghan refugees who assisted Western forces face growing uncertainty as European nations tighten immigration laws. Despite integrating into society and having support from their previous employers, thousands now struggle with downgraded residency permits. These individuals fear for their safety and stability as shifting political climates threaten the futures they worked hard to build.
amharic: በምዕራባውያን ኃይሎች በኩል ይረዱ የነበሩ በርካታ አፍጋኒስታናውያን ስደተኞች የአውሮፓ ሀገራት የኢሚግሬሽን ህጎቻቸውን በማጥበቃቸው ምክንያት ከፍተኛ እርግጠኛ አለመሆን ገጥሟቸዋል። በማህበረሰቡ ውስጥ ተቀላቅለው እና የቀድሞ አሰሪዎቻቸው ድጋፍ ቢኖራቸውም፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩት አሁን በጊዜያዊ የመኖሪያ ፈቃድ ምክንያት ችግር ውስጥ ገብተዋል። እያደገ የመጣው የፖለቲካ ለውጥ ለሰላማዊ ህይወታቸው ስጋት እየፈጠረባቸው በመሆኑ፣ የወደፊት እጣ ፈንታቸው አሳሳቢ ሆኗል።
oromo: Namoonni baqattoota Afgaanistaan kan humnoota dhihaa gargaaraa turan, biyyoonni Awurooppaa seera isaanii jabeessuun walqabatee rakkoo cimaa keessa jiru. Hawaasa keessatti kan makaman ta'us, bu'uura seeraa jijjiramee jiruun kumaan lakkaa'aman hayyama bakka jiraannaa yeroo qofa argachaa jiru. Jijjiiramni siyaasaa kun jireenya isaanii irratti miidhaa waan fiduuf, gara fuulduraatti maal akka isaan mudatu beekuun isaanitti ulfaateera.

title: Is China seeking to copy Iran’s Strait of Hormuz blockade around Taiwan?
english: Military analysts are concerned that China might use a maritime blockade around Taiwan similar to Iran's tactics in the Strait of Hormuz. Because the world relies heavily on Taiwan's semiconductor industry, such a move would cause significant global economic disruption. Authorities in Taiwan are currently evaluating their defense strategies against these potential threats while some residents remain resolute in their resistance.
amharic: የወታደራዊ ጉዳዮች ተንታኞች ቻይና በታይዋን ዙሪያ ልክ እንደ ኢራን በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ እንደምትጠቀምበት አይነት የባህር ላይ እገዳ ልትጥል እንደምትችል ስጋታቸውን እየገለጹ ነው። ዓለም በታይዋን ሴሚኮንዳክተር ኢንዱስትሪ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጥገኛ በመሆኗ እንዲህ ያለ እርምጃ በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ከፍተኛ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ቀውስ ሊያስከትል ይችላል። የታይዋን ባለስልጣናት እነዚህን ሊከሰቱ የሚችሉ ስጋቶች ለመከላከል የመከላከያ ስልቶቻቸውን እየገመገሙ ሲሆን፣ አንዳንድ የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎችም በፅናት ለመከላከል ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን እያሳዩ ነው።
oromo: Ogeeyyonni waraanaa akka yaadanitti, Chaayinaan tarsiimoo Iraan bishaan galaana Hormuz irratti fayyadamtuu hordoftee Taiwan irratti uggura galaanaa gochuu dandeessi jedhamee sodaatama. Addunyaan oomisha kutaalee elektirooniksii (semiconductor) Taiwan irratti hirkattummaa olaanaa waan qabduuf, gochi akkasii dinagdee addunyaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisuu danda'a. Mootummaan Taiwan balaa kana ittisuuf tarsiimoo isaa qorachaa jiru, jiraattonnis of ittisuuf kutannoo qabu.

title: Modi threatens to target ‘intellectual Naxals’ in Independence Day speech
english: In his Independence Day speech, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi declared that the long-standing armed Maoist rebellion in India has been largely defeated. However, he warned that 'intellectual Naxals' remain a danger and must be identified and isolated for their potential to incite violence. This rhetoric follows recent youth-led protests against his administration, while Modi also used the address to promote his vision for India's economic development by 2047.
amharic: የህንድ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናሬንድራ ሞዲ በነጻነት ቀናቸው ንግግራቸው ወቅት ለበርካታ አስርት ዓመታት የዘለቀው የታጠቁ የማኦኢስት አማፂያን እንቅስቃሴ በአብዛኛው መደምሰሱን አስታውቀዋል። ይሁን እንጂ 'አዕምሯዊ ናክሳሎች' ወይም የአስተሳሰብ ደጋፊዎች አሁንም ለሀገሪቱ ስጋት እንደሆኑ በመግለጽ፣ እነዚህ አካላት መለየት እና መገለል እንዳለባቸው አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ ንግግራቸው በመንግስታቸው ላይ እየተካሄደ ካለው የወጣቶች ተቃውሞ ጋር የተያያዘ ሲሆን፣ በተመሳሳይ ሁኔታ የሀገሪቱን የኢኮኖሚ እድገት እቅድ አጉልተው አሳይተዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Muummee Indiyaa Naarendraa Moodii guyyaa walabaa biyyattii irratti haasaa taasisaniin, finxaaltonni Mao’istii waggoota dheeraaf biyyattiin lolamaa turan guutummaatti dhaabbachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Haa ta’u malee, 'naaksaalonni sammuu' jedhaman ykn deeggartoonni yaadaa kun amma iyyuu biyyattii keessatti yaaddoo ta’uu isaanii fi adda baafamanii addaan qophaa’uu akka qaban akeekkachiisaniiru. Haasaa kanaan, mormii dargaggootaa mootummaa isaa irratti ka’aa jiru kan xiyyeeffatan yoo ta’u, gama biraatiin immoo fuulduratti karoora guddina diinagdee biyyattii irratti xiyyeeffataniiru.

title: Aftermath of deadly Indonesia earthquake
english: A powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake recently struck near Indonesia's Flores Island, resulting in dozens of deaths. Rescue workers are currently struggling to reach isolated communities in the East Nusa Tenggara region to search for survivors. Ongoing aftershocks are further complicating these emergency response efforts.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዥያ ፍሎሬስ ደሴት አቅራቢያ የደረሰው ከፍተኛ የ7.7 ማግኒቱድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ የብዙ ሰዎችን ሕይወት ቀጥፏል። የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች በተጎዱ አካባቢዎች ያሉ የተረፉ ሰዎችን ለመፈለግ እየጣሩ ቢሆንም፣ የትራንስፖርት ችግር ስራውን አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል። ተከታታይ የሆኑ ተረፈ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጦችም የነፍስ አድን ስራውን እያስተጓጎሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Indooneziyaa, ganda Flores jedhamu biratti dhoo'insa lafaa cimaa humni isaa 7.7 ta'een lubbuun namoota hedduu darbeera. Gareen gargaarsaa namoota balaa kana keessatti hafanii fi miidhaman barbaaduuf tattaafataa jiru, ta'us rakkoon daandii iddoo hunda ga'uuf isaan dhibeera. Dhoo'insi lafaa itti aanuunis hojii fayyinsaa kana caalaatti ulfaata taasiseera.

title: Japanese minister visits shrine to war dead, angering China, South Korea
english: Japan's Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi visited the controversial Yasukuni Shrine on the 81st anniversary of Japan's surrender in World War II. The site is viewed by China and South Korea as a symbol of Japanese wartime aggression because it honors convicted war criminals alongside other soldiers. Both neighboring nations strongly protested the visit and the Prime Minister’s decision to send a ritual offering, urging Japan to show more sincere remorse for its past actions.
amharic: የጃፓን የመከላከያ ሚኒስትር ሺንጂሮ ኮይዙሚ በሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት የጃፓን መሸነፍ 81ኛ ዓመት በዓል ላይ ያሱኩኒ የተባለውን አወዛጋቢ ቤተ መቅደስ ጎብኝተዋል። ይህ ስፍራ የተወገዙ የጦር ወንጀለኞችን ጭምር የሚዘክር በመሆኑ፣ ቻይና እና ደቡብ ኮሪያ እንደ ጃፓን የጦር ወንጀል ምልክት በመቁጠር ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ አሰምተዋል። ሁለቱ አገራት የጃፓን መሪዎች ለታሪካዊ ጥፋቶቻቸው እውነተኛ ይቅርታ እንዲጠይቁ በማሳሰብ፣ የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሯን የልገሳ ስጦታም ጭምር አውግዘዋል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyyaa Jaappaan Shinjiro Koizumi, guyyaa Jaappaan lola addunyaa lammaffaa irratti injifatamtetti waggaa 81ffaa irratti mana sagadaa Yasukuni jedhamu kan mormii guddaa kaase daawwateera. Mana sagadaa kana keessatti yakka waraanaa irratti hirmaatanis waan yaadatamaniif, biyyoonni ollaashee Chaayinaa fi Kooriyaan Kibbaa gocha kana akka mallattoo yakka waraanaa durii Jaappaanitti fudhatanii mormii guddaa qaqqabsiisaniiru. Biyyoonni lamaanuu mootummaan Jaappaan darbeef gaabbii dhugaa akka galuufi kennaa mummichi ministeeraa mana sagadaa sanatti erge akka morman ibsaniiru.

title: Seven killed in Israeli strike on southern Lebanon, country's PM says
english: An Israeli airstrike in southern Lebanon killed seven people, including three children and two women, after hitting a house where displaced families were sheltering. The Lebanese Prime Minister condemned the attack as an escalation, while the Israeli military claimed the strike targeted Hezbollah infrastructure following regional hostilities. Additional attacks in the area have also resulted in further casualties and significant destruction.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት ሶስት ህጻናትን እና ሁለት ሴቶችን ጨምሮ ሰባት ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። የተፈናቀሉ ቤተሰቦች በሚኖሩበት ቤት ላይ የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት የሊባኖስ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ያወገዙ ሲሆን እስራኤል በበኩሏ የሂዝቦላህን መሠረተ ልማቶች ኢላማ ማድረጓን ገልጻለች። በሌሎች አካባቢዎች በተፈጸሙ ተያያዥ ጥቃቶችም ተጨማሪ ጉዳቶች እና የንብረት ውድመቶች ደርሰዋል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el kibba Libanon keessatti haleellaa xiyyaaraan geggeessuun ijoollee sadii fi dubartoota lama dabalatee namoota torba ajjeeseera. Haleellaan kun manni jireenyaa maatii buqqa'anii turan keessa jiraatan irratti kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, muummeen ministiraa Libanon gochicha balaaleffataniiru. Israa'el gama ishiitiin haleellaan kun bu'uuraalee misoomaa garee Hizbullaah irratti kan xiyyeeffate ta'uu ibsite; naannolee biroo keessattis haleellaa walfakkaataa raawwatameen miidhaan garaagaraa gahuu gabaasameera.

title: What the Taliban achieved and failed to achieve in five years
english: Five years after taking power, the Taliban has succeeded in establishing nationwide control and improving overall security across Afghanistan, making travel much safer than it was previously. While the economy suffered after foreign aid was withdrawn, the government has managed to prevent total collapse by stabilizing basic economic activity and natural resource extraction. However, despite these gains in stability, the Taliban faces significant challenges regarding its lack of popularity and the long-term sustainability of the country's economic and social situation.
amharic: ታሊባን ወደ ስልጣን ከመጣ አምስት ዓመታት በኋላ በመላው አፍጋኒስታን ላይ ቁጥጥር በማድረግ ደህንነትን ማሻሻል ችሏል፣ ይህም የዜጎችን የመንቀሳቀስ ነጻነት ቀደም ሲል ከነበረው የበለጠ አስተማማኝ አድርጎታል። የውጭ እርዳታ በመቋረጡ ኢኮኖሚው ከፍተኛ ቀውስ ቢገጥመውም፣ መንግስት መሰረታዊ ኢኮኖሚያዊ እንቅስቃሴዎችን እና የተፈጥሮ ሀብት ብዝበዛን በመቆጣጠር ሙሉ ውድቀትን መከላከል ችሏል። ይሁን እንጂ፣ እነዚህ የጸጥታ መሻሻሎች ቢኖሩም፣ ቡድኑ በህዝብ ዘንድ ያለው ተቀባይነት መቀነስ እና የሀገሪቱን ኢኮኖሚያዊና ማህበራዊ የወደፊት እጣ ፈንታ በተመለከተ አሁንም ትልቅ ፈተናዎች ተጋርጠውበታል።
oromo: Talibaan aangootti erga deebi'ee waggaa shan booda, guutuu Afgaanistaan to’achuufi nageenya biyyattii fooyyessuu danda’eera, kunis namoonni iddoo tokkoo gara biraatti nagaan akka socho’an taasiseera. Gargaarsi alaa erga dhaabbatee booda dinagdee biyyattii miidhaan cimaan irra ga’us, mootummaan hojiilee dinagdee bu’uuraafi fayyadama qabeenya uumamaa to’achuun kufaatii guutuu ittisuu danda’eera. Ta’us, nageenya fooyyeffachuu kana keessattis, mootummaan kun fudhatama ummataa dhabuufi rakkoolee dinagdee akkasumas hawaasummaa gara fuulduraa mudachuu danda’an irra aanuuf dorgommii cimaa keessa jira.

title: World Cup winner Ferran Torres joins Paris Saint-Germain from Barcelona
english: Spanish striker Ferran Torres has officially transferred from Barcelona to Paris Saint-Germain for approximately 50 million euros. The 26-year-old World Cup winner, who scored the decisive goal in the recent final, has committed to a five-year contract with the French club. Torres expressed his excitement about joining the team and reuniting with his former national coach, Luis Enrique.
amharic: የስፔኑ አጥቂ ፌራን ቶረስ ከባርሴሎና ወደ ፓሪስ ሴንት ዠርሜይን በ50 ሚሊዮን ዩሮ ዝውውር ተቀላቅሏል። የ26 ዓመቱ የዓለም ዋንጫ አሸናፊ፣ በቅርቡ በተጠናቀቀው የዓለም ዋንጫ የፍጻሜ ጨዋታ ወሳኝ ግብ ማስቆጠር ችሎ ነበር። ተጫዋቹ ከፈረንሳይ ክለብ ጋር ለአምስት ዓመታት የሚቆይ ውል የተፈራረመ ሲሆን፣ ከቀድሞ አሰልጣኙ ሉዊስ ኤንሪኬ ጋር በመገናኘቱ ደስታውን ገልጿል።
oromo: Garee kubbaa miilaa Ispeen kan ta'e Ferran Torres, gatii Euro miliyoona 50 ta'een Barcelona gadhiisee gara Paris Saint-Germain godaaneera. Umriin isaa waggaa 26 kan ta'e fi mo'ataa Waancaa Addunyaa kun, xumura dorgommii darbe irratti goolii injifannoo galcheera. Taphatichi kilabii Faransaay kana waliin walii galtee waggaa shan kan mallatteesse yoo ta'u, leenjisaa isaa duraanii Luis Enrique waliin walitti deebi'uusaatti gammachuu isaa ibseera.

title: Arsenal vs Manchester City: Community Shield – prediction, lineups, teams
english: Arsenal and Manchester City are set to face off in the Community Shield match held at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff. This highly anticipated season opener features a major transition for City, as Enzo Maresca takes charge for his first competitive game after succeeding Pep Guardiola. Meanwhile, Arsenal enters the contest aiming to prove their strength as defending Premier League champions.
amharic: አርሰናል እና ማንቸስተር ሲቲ በካርዲፍ በሚገኘው ፕሪንሲፓሊቲ ስታዲየም ለኮሚዩኒቲ ሺልድ ዋንጫ ይፋለማሉ። ይህ በጉጉት የሚጠበቀው የውድድር ዘመን መክፈቻ ጨዋታ፣ ኤንዞ ማሬስካ ከፔፕ ጋርዲዮላ በመረከብ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በይፋዊ ውድድር ሲቲን የሚመሩበት ነው። በሌላ በኩል፣ አርሰናል የፕሪሚየር ሊግ ሻምፒዮንነቱን ለማስጠበቅ ያለውን ብቃት ለማሳየት ዝግጅቱን አጠናቋል።
oromo: Arsenal fi Manchester City tapha Community Shield kan Cardiff, Principality Stadium irratti gaggeeffamuuf qophaa’aa jiru. Taphi kun jijjiirama guddaa Manchester City keessatti mul’atu kan agarsiisu yoo ta’u, Enzo Marescan erga Pep Guardiola bakka bu’ee booda gorsa taphataa ta’ee garee isaa dursuun kan jalqabuudha. Gama biraatiin, Arsenal mo’ataa liigii kan ta’an amantii qaban irratti hundaa’uun qophiidha.

title: At scene of deadly Israeli strike on Lebanon home
english: An overnight Israeli airstrike hit a residential home in the southern Lebanese town of Ansar. The attack resulted in the deaths of at least seven people, including children. Ongoing military actions continue to cause significant destruction throughout the southern region.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ አንሳር ከተማ ውስጥ በሚገኝ አንድ መኖሪያ ቤት ላይ እስራኤል ባደረሰችው የሌሊት የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ ሰባት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ከተገደሉት መካከል ህጻናት እንደሚገኙበት ተገልጿል። በሊባኖስ ደቡባዊ ክፍል የሚካሄዱት ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃቶች ከፍተኛ ውድመት እያስከተሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Halkan darbetti xiyyiirri waraana Israa'el ganda Ansaar kan kibba Libaanoositti argamu keessatti mana jireenyaa tokko rukutee jira. Hojii waraana kanaan namoonni yoo xiqqaate torba du'aniiru; isaan keessas ijoolleen akka jiran gabaafameera. Haleellaa fi badiin naannoo kibba Libaanoos keessatti bal'inaan itti fufee jira.

title: South Korea proposes talks to officially end war with North
english: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung has invited North Korea to engage in formal discussions aimed at officially concluding the Korean War. The proposal seeks to establish a security framework to lower border tensions and includes an offer to negotiate a halt to the North's nuclear weapons program. This initiative represents a push for diplomatic resolution after decades of a frozen conflict governed only by an armistice.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያው ፕሬዝዳንት ሊ ጄ ማዩንግ በሁለቱ ኮሪያዎች መካከል ያለውን ጦርነት በይፋ ለማቆም ከሰሜን ኮሪያ ጋር ድርድር እንዲጀመር ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ይህ ሀሳብ በድንበር አካባቢ ያለውን ውጥረት ለመቀነስ የሚያስችል የደህንነት ማዕቀፍ ለመፍጠር እና የሰሜን ኮሪያን የኑክሌር ፕሮግራም ለመግታት ያለመ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ ከ1953 የጦርነት ማቆም ስምምነት ወዲህ ለረጅም ጊዜ የዘለቀውን ውጥረት በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ለመፍታት ያለመ ጥረት ነው።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Koriyaa Kibbaa Lee Jae Myung waraana biyyoota lamaanii seeraan xumuruuf marii seena qabeessa ta'e akka jalqabamu Koriyaa Kaabaatti waamicha dhiyeessaniiru. Yaada kana keessatti daangaa irratti nageenya mirkaneessuu fi sagantaa meeshaa niwukilaraa Koriyaa Kaabaa dhaabsisuurratti mari'achuun kaayyeffameera. Tarkaanfiin kun waliigaltee waraana dhaabuu bara 1953 irraa kaasee jijjiirama dhabee ture furmaata dippilomaasii fayyadamuun furuuf kan yaalameedha.

title: Bangladesh rock Australia as historic Test win in sight
english: Bangladesh is on the verge of a historic Test cricket victory in Australia after a strong performance by their bowlers on the third day. The touring team reduced Australia to 161-4, leaving them trailing by 67 runs, thanks to crucial wickets from Hasan Mahmud and Mehidy Hasan Miraz. Despite being heavy underdogs, Bangladesh has dominated the match by bowling effectively and batting with great discipline.
amharic: ባንግላዲሽ በአውስትራሊያ እየተካሄደ ባለው የቴስት ክሪኬት ጨዋታ በሦስተኛው ቀን ባሳዩት ብቃት ታሪካዊ ድል ለመቀዳጀት ተቃርበዋል። የባንግላዲሽ ቦለሮች አውስትራሊያን በ161-4 በማቆም ከ67 ሩጫዎች በኋላ እንዲከተሏቸው አድርገዋል። ምንም እንኳን ባንግላዲሽ በውድድሩ ደካማ ተፎካካሪ ተብለው ቢጠበቁም፣ በቦሊንግ እና በባትቲንግ ባሳዩት የላቀ ጥምረት ጨዋታውን መቆጣጠር ችለዋል።
oromo: Bangladesh taphicha cricket Test Awustiraaliyaa irratti gaggeeffamaa jiruun injifannoo seena qabeessa ta’e argachuuf qarqara irra ga’eera. Guyyaa sadaffaatti taphattootni baolii (bowlers) Bangladesh dhiibbaa cimaa uumuun Awustiraaliyaa 161-4 irratti akka dhaabatan godhaniiru. Akkaataa kanaan gareen Awustiraaliyaa 67 runs baay’inni isaa xiqqatee jira. Bangladeshis garee dadhabaa ta’anii kanneen tilmaamaman ta’us, qindoomina taphaan dorgommii kana harka isaanii galfataniiru.

title: FIFA World Cup and Olympics cited as Coe warns of politicians near sport
english: World Athletics President Sebastian Coe recently emphasized that while sports organizations should maintain strong working relationships with governments, they must strictly prevent politicians from influencing sporting decisions. He expressed concern over political interference, specifically referencing a controversial FIFA incident where a presidential call led to the overturning of a player's suspension. As the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics approach, Coe urged sports bodies to remain resilient and independent to ensure the integrity of international competitions.
amharic: የዓለም አትሌቲክስ ፕሬዝዳንት ሴባስቲያን ኮይ የስፖርት ድርጅቶች ከመንግስት ጋር ጥሩ ግንኙነት ሊኖራቸው ቢገባም፣ ፖለቲከኞች ግን በስፖርት ውሳኔዎች ውስጥ ጣልቃ እንዳይገቡ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተዋል። በተለይም የፊፋው ፕሬዝዳንት የፖለቲካ ግፊት ደርሶባቸው የተጫዋች ቅጣትን መሻራቸውን በመጥቀስ፣ የስፖርት አመራሮች እንዲህ አይነት ተጽዕኖዎችን መቋቋም እንዳለባቸው አስገንዝበዋል። እ.ኤ.አ በ2028 የሚካሄደው የሎስ አንጀለስ ኦሊምፒክ ከመድረሱ በፊት የስፖርት አካላት ከፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ ነጻ መሆናቸውን እንዲያረጋግጡም አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Atleetiksii Addunyaa Sebaastiyaan Koye, dhaabbileen ispoortii mootummoota waliin walitti dhufeenya gaarii qabaachuu qabanis, siyaasniifi siyaas-toltotaan murtee ispoortii keessa galuu akka hin qabne akeekkachiisaniiru. Keessattuu, dhiibbaa siyaasaa FIFA mudateefi murtee adabbii taphataa jijjiiruu qorachaa, qaamoleen ispoortii dhiibbaa akkanaa mormuuf cimina qabaachuu akka qaban ibsaniiru. Olompikii Los Anjeeles kan bara 2028 dhiyaachaa jiru ilaalchisee, dhaabbileen ispoortii walaba ta'anii fi dhiibbaa siyaasarraa bilisa ta'anii hojjechuu akka qaban dhaamaniiru.

title: How a pragmatic axis could reshape the Middle East
english: The Middle East is seeing a potential shift in power as a new 'Sunni axis' involving Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan emerges. This grouping recently took steps toward a collective defense agreement, suggesting a move away from the traditional rivalry between Iran’s regional network and the US-Israeli security model. These developments reflect a regional desire to move past the failures of previous strategies following the intense conflicts and instability seen over the last few years.
amharic: ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታንን ያካተተ አዲስ የክልሉ የኃይል ማዕከል እየተፈጠረ በመሆኑ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የፖለቲካ ለውጥ እየታየ ነው። እነዚህ ሀገራት የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ መጀመራቸው፣ ቀደም ሲል በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ-እስራኤል ጥምረት መካከል የነበረውን የቆየ የኃይል ሚዛን ሊቀይር ይችላል። ይህ አካሄድ ባለፉት ጥቂት ዓመታት በክልሉ የታዩትን ግጭቶችና የፖለቲካ ውድቀቶች ተከትሎ የመጣ አዲስ የዲፕሎማሲ ለውጥ ነው።
oromo: Ardii Baha Giddu-galeessaa keessatti sa'udi Arabiyaa, Turkii fi Paakistaan kan hirmaatan sadarkaa humnaa haarawa tokko uumamaa jira. Biyyoonni kunneen waliigaltee ittisa waloo uumuuf tarkaanfii fudhachaa jiran kun, morkii yeroo dheeraaf Iran fi gamtaa Ameerikaa-Israa'el gidduutti ture jijjiiruu danda'a. Tarkaanfiin kun kan agarsiisu, waggoota muraasa darban keessa jeequmsa fi kisaaraa mudate booda, biyyoonni kunneen tarsiimoo siyaasaa haarawa hordofuuf murteessuu isaanii dha.

title: Five years of Taliban rule: A state has survived, but at what cost?
english: Five years after taking power, the Taliban has successfully consolidated control over Afghanistan, creating a stable but strictly authoritarian regime. While they have improved domestic security, the country faces severe economic hardship, international isolation, and harsh restrictions on women. True authority remains centered around their supreme leader in Kandahar, who relies on a vast network of religious schools to maintain loyalty and enforce strict rule.
amharic: የታሊባን ቡድን ስልጣን ከያዘ ከአምስት ዓመታት በኋላ አፍጋኒስታንን በተረጋጋ ነገር ግን በአምባገነናዊ አገዛዝ ስር ማስተዳደር ችሏል። የሀገር ውስጥ ደህንነት ቢሻሻልም፣ ሀገሪቱ ከባድ የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ፣ ዓለም አቀፍ መገለል እና በሴቶች ላይ የተጣሉ ከባድ ገደቦች ተጋርጠውባታል። ዋናው ስልጣን በካንዳሃር ባለው መሪ እጅ የተከማቸ ሲሆን፣ እሳቸውም ታማኝነታቸውን ለማስጠበቅ እና አገዛዛቸውን ለማጠናከር በሃይማኖታዊ ትምህርት ቤቶች አውታረ መረብ ይጠቀማሉ።
oromo: Taalibaan biyyaa qabatanii waggaa shan booda, Afgaanistaan keessatti nagaa buusuuf yaalanii ta’us mootummaan isaanii mirga namaa sarbuun beekama. Biyyi kun amma tasgabbooftee jirti, garuu rakkoo dinagdee cimaa, addunyaa irraa addaan ba’uu fi dubartoota irratti uggura cimaa kaa’uu irra darbee jira. Aangoon hundi harka hogganaa isaanii isa Kandahaar jiru kan jiru yoo ta’u, isaanis biyyattii to’achuuf mana barumsaa amantii irratti hirkatu.

title: Israeli forces fire tear gas canisters at Palestinian homes in Ramallah
english: Israeli military forces deployed tear gas against Palestinian homes in the village of Al-Mughayir following an attempt by residents to stop an attack by Israeli settlers. Additionally, reports indicate that Israeli forces have taken over several homes in the town of Beita. These incidents occurred amidst rising tensions in the occupied West Bank.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በአል-ሙጋይር መንደር የሚገኙ የፍልስጤማውያንን ቤቶች በእንባ ጋዝ አጥቅተዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች በእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች የተቃጣባቸውን ጥቃት ለመከላከል በሞከሩበት ወቅት ነው። በሌላ በኩል በናብሉስ በኩል በሚገኘው ቤይታ ከተማ ውስጥ የእስራኤል ኃይሎች የፍልስጤማውያንን መኖሪያ ቤቶች ተቆጣጥረዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el ganda Al-Mugayir keessatti mana jireenyaa Falasxiinotaa irratti gaazii imimmaan fidu fayyadamaniiru. Kunis kan ta'e, jiraattonni naannichaa haleellaa qotee bulaa Israa'el irraa isaan irra ga'e ofirraa ittisuuf yaalii taasisan hordofee dha. Kana malees, magaalota ganda Beeyitaa keessattis humnoonni Israa'el manneen jireenyaa Falasxiinotaa to'annoo isaanii jala galchuun gabaasameera.

title: UN says 900 ‘physical obstacles’ delay, limit aid to West Bank
english: The United Nations reports that over 900 physical barriers, such as checkpoints and roadblocks, are severely hindering humanitarian aid delivery in the West Bank. Currently, three Palestinian families in the village of Qusra are cut off from essential supplies like food and medicine due to these restrictions and the recent presence of a nearby settler outpost. Despite international efforts, aid organizations have been unable to reach these trapped residents to provide critical assistance.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እንደገለጸው ከ900 በላይ የሆኑ መሰናክሎች ማለትም የፍተሻ ጣቢያዎች እና የመንገድ መዝጊያዎች በዌስት ባንክ የሚደረገውን የሰብአዊ እርዳታ አቅርቦት በእጅጉ እያስተጓጎሉ ነው። በቁስራ መንደር የሚገኙ ሶስት የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦች በአካባቢው በተፈጠሩ የመንገድ ገደቦች እና በአቅራቢያቸው በተቋቋመ የሰፈራ ጣቢያ ምክንያት አስፈላጊ የሆኑ የምግብ እና የህክምና ቁሳቁሶችን ማግኘት አልቻሉም። አለም አቀፍ ድርጅቶች እነዚህን ተጎጂ ቤተሰቦች ለመርዳት የሚያደርጉት ጥረት በፀጥታ ችግሮች ምክንያት ሳይሳካ ቀርቷል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka ibsetti, gufuuleen 900 ol ta'an kan akka iddoo qormaataa fi daandii cufamanii gargaarsi namoomaa Naannoo Lixaa (West Bank) akka hin geenye danqaa ta'aniiru. Magaala Qusraa keessatti maatiin lammii Falasxiinii sadii sababa uggura daandii fi qubsuma qonnaan bultootaa biratti ijaaramee jiruun, nyaataa fi qorichaa dhabuun rakkoo hamaa keessa jiru. Dhaabbileen gargaarsa namoomaa maatii kana bira gahuuf carraaqqii godhanis, dhiibbaa jiruun gargaarsa geessisuu hin dandeenye.

title: Morning recap
english: President Trump has threatened to claim the Strait of Hormuz as US territory following a conflict with Iran, drawing sharp rebukes from Tehran. Meanwhile, regional tensions remain high as multiple ships were attacked in the Strait and Israeli airstrikes caused fatalities in Lebanon. Additionally, violent incidents were reported in the West Bank and Yemen, while Iran indicated it is not currently prepared to restart formal negotiations with Washington.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ኢራንን ካሸነፉ በኋላ የሆርሙዝ ስትሬትን የአሜሪካ ግዛት እንደሚያደርጉት በመግለጻቸው በቴህራን በኩል ጠንካራ ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸዋል። ይህ በእንዲህ እንዳለ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ላይ በበርካታ መርከቦች ላይ ጥቃት በመሰንዘሩ እና እስራኤል በሊባኖስ በፈጸመችው የአየር ጥቃት የሰው ህይወት በመጥፋቱ የክልሉ ሁኔታ ተባብሷል። በሌላ በኩል በዌስት ባንክ እና በየመን ግጭቶች እየተካሄዱ ሲሆን ኢራንም ከአሜሪካ ጋር የሰላም ድርድር ለመጀመር እስካሁን ዝግጁ አለመሆኗን አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Pirezidaant Traamp erga Iraan mo'atanii booda balbala Hormuz biyya Ameerikaa jala akka galchan himuun isaanii, Teheran biratti mormii cimaa kaasera. Kana gidduutti, balbala Hormuz irratti markaboota hedduu irratti haleellaan raawwatamuun fi haleellaan xiyyaraa Israa'el Libaanos keessatti lubbuu namootaa galaafachuu isaatiin walqabatee rakkoon naannichaa hammeenya irra jira. Gama biraatiin, Naannoo Daangaa Lixa (West Bank) fi Yaman keessatti walitti bu'iinsi kan jiru yoo ta'u, Iraanis yeroo ammaa kana Ameerikaa waliin marii idilee jalqabuuf akka hin qophoofne ibsiteetti.

title: Venus Williams hits 13-game tennis losing streak with Cincinnati Open exit
english: Tennis star Venus Williams has extended her singles losing streak to 13 matches after a straight-sets defeat to Emiliana Arango at the Cincinnati Open. The 46-year-old seven-time Grand Slam champion, who received a wild-card entry, has not secured a singles victory since July 2025. Despite this setback, Williams plans to remain in the tournament to compete in the doubles event alongside her sister, Serena.
amharic: የቴኒስ ኮከቧ ቬነስ ዊሊያምስ በሲንሲናቲ ኦፕን በተደረገው ውድድር በኤሚሊያና አራንጎ ከተሸነፈች በኋላ በነጠላ ጨዋታ ያላት ተከታታይ ሽንፈት ወደ 13 ደርሷል። በዱር ካርድ (wild-card) ወደ ውድድሩ የገባችው የ46 ዓመቷ የሰባት ግራንድ ስላም አሸናፊ፣ ከጁላይ 2025 ወዲህ አንድም የነጠላ ጨዋታ ድል አላስመዘገበችም። ሆኖም ዊሊያምስ ከእህቷ ከሴሬና ዊሊያምስ ጋር በመሆን በድርብ ጨዋታ ለመወዳደር በውድድሩ ላይ ትቆያለች።
oromo: Taphattuun tenisiin beekamtuu Venus Williams tapha tokko-tokkoon (singles) mo'atamtee, walitti aansuun tapha 13 mo'atamte jirti. Mo'atamuu ishee kanas kan mudate tapha Cincinnati Open irratti Emiliana Arango irratti ta'e. Akkaataa addaatiin (wild-card) kan hirmaattee fi umuriin ishee waggaa 46 kan ta'e, injifannoo tokko iyyuu kan hin arganne Adoolessa 2025 irraa kaasee dha. Ta'us, Venus obboleettii ishee Serena waliin tapha lama-lamaa (doubles) irratti hirmaachuuf dorgommii kana itti fufti.

title: The women India’s biggest river project forgot
english: Thousands of Indigenous people in India's Madhya Pradesh state face displacement due to the massive Ken-Betwa river-linking project. Women from these affected communities are staging protest funeral pyres to symbolize the loss of their homes and livelihoods without receiving proper legal compensation. These families, many of whom belong to the Gond tribe, rely heavily on the forest and now fear total abandonment by the government as their lands prepare to be submerged.
amharic: በህንድ ማድያ ፕራዴሽ ግዛት እየተካሄደ ባለው ትልቅ የወንዞች ማገናኘት ፕሮጀክት ሳቢያ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተወላጆች ከመኖሪያቸው የመፈናቀል ስጋት ተጋርጦባቸዋል። ጉዳዩ የሚመለከታቸው ማህበረሰብ ሴቶች፣ ህጋዊ ካሳ ሳይከፈላቸው ቤታቸውን እንደሚያጡ በመግለጽ የለቅሶ መድረክ በማዘጋጀት ተቃውሟቸውን እየገለጹ ይገኛሉ። በአብዛኛው የጎንድ ጎሳ አባላት የሆኑት እነዚህ ቤተሰቦች ከደን ሀብት በሚያገኙት ምርት የሚተዳደሩ ሲሆን፣ አሁን ግን የመንግስት ትኩረት እና ተገቢ ካሳ ባለማግኘታቸው ለከፍተኛ ችግር ተዳርገዋል።
oromo: Indiyaa keessatti piroojektiin laggeen wal-quunnamsiisuu guddaan kun lammiilee kumaatamaan lakkaawwaman naannoo Madhya Pradesh irraa buqqisaa jira. Dubartoonni hawaasa kanaa, beenyaan seera qabeessi osoo hin kaffalamiin manneen isaanii fi jiraachuu isaanii akka dhaban ibsuuf, sirna awwaala fakkaatuun mormii guddaa gaggeessaa jiru. Namoonni gosa Gond irraa dhuftan kunneen jireenya isaanii bosona irra kan hundeeffatan yoo ta'u, amma qabeenyi isaanii bishaan jalatti buluuf qophaa'aa waan jiruuf gargaarsa mootummaa dhabuu isaaniitti gaddanii jiru.

title: Tributes paid to Jason Arday after ex-Cambridge professor found dead
english: Jason Arday, a former Cambridge professor, has died at the age of 41 in London. His family expressed that he was overwhelmed by a campaign of misinformation following his recent resignation over plagiarism allegations, which he had denied. Prominent figures including Sadiq Khan and university colleagues have paid tribute to him, highlighting the intense and damaging public scrutiny he endured prior to his death.
amharic: የቀድሞው የካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ፕሮፌሰር የሆኑት ጄሰን አርዳይ በ41 ዓመታቸው በለንደን ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ቤተሰቦቻቸው እንደገለጹት፣ አርዳይ ከዚህ ቀደም በቀረበበት የቅጅ ስርቆት ክስ ምክንያት ከስራው ከለቀቀ በኋላ ከፍተኛ የሃሰት ወሬዎች እና ጫናዎች ሲደርሱበት ነበር። የለንደን ከንቲባ ሳዲቅ ካን እና ሌሎች የስራ ባልደረቦቹ፣ አርዳይ ከመሞቱ በፊት በብዙዎች ዘንድ ከፍተኛ የሆነ አድሎአዊ የህዝብ ትችት እና ጫና ይደርስበት እንደነበር በመግለጽ ሀዘናቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pirofesara Yuunivarsitii Kaambirijii duraanii Jeeson Ardaayi ganna 41tti magaala London keessatti du'aan boqotee jira. Maatiin isaa akka ibsanitti, himannaa hanna barruu irratti dhiyaatee tureef hojii isaa erga gadi lakkisee booda, duula odeeffannoo sobaa isa irratti gaggeeffamaa tureef baay'ee miidhamaa akka ture ibsaniiru. Kantiibaan magaala London Saadiq Kaan fi hiriyoonni hojii isaa, Ardaayi lubbuun isaa darbuun dura duula miidiyaafi jibbaa hamaa keessa akka ture hubachiisuun gadda itti dhaga'ame ibsaniiru.

title: Arteta assures Arsenal fans over contract before Man City clash
english: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta has reassured supporters that his contract situation is not a cause for concern as he enters the final year of his deal. Despite recent speculation, the manager confirmed his strong desire to stay at the club and emphasized that reaching an agreement is only a matter of time. He noted that focusing on summer transfer activities took precedence, but both he and the club remain committed to extending his tenure.
amharic: የአርሰናል አሰልጣኝ ሚኬል አርቴታ በውላቸው የመጨረሻ ዓመት ላይ ቢሆኑም ጉዳዩ አሳሳቢ እንዳልሆነ ለደጋፊዎች አረጋግጠዋል። አሰልጣኙ በክለቡ የመቆየት ከፍተኛ ፍላጎት እንዳላቸው ገልጸው፣ የውል ስምምነቱ በቅርቡ እንደሚፈታ ያላቸውን እምነት ተናግረዋል። አርቴታ ትኩረታቸው ቀድሞ የነበረው በክረምቱ የዝውውር እንቅስቃሴ ላይ እንደሆነ ጠቅሰው፣ በራሳቸው እና በክለቡ መካከል ያለው ግንኙነት ጠንካራ መሆኑን አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Leenjisaan Arsenal Mikel Arteta waggaa isaa isa dhumaa irratti kan argamu ta’us, haalli kontiraata isaa akka hin yaaddofneef deggertoota isaanii mirkaneessaniiru. Leenjisichi kutaannoo cimaa garee kana keessa turuuf qaban ibsuun, waliigalteen kontiraataa yeroo gabaabaa keessatti akka raawwatamu amantii qaban dubbataniiru. Xiyyeeffannaan isaanii duraan hojii gabaa gannaatiif kennamee akka ture himanii, isaanis ta’e gareen sun waliin hojjechuuf fedhii cimaa akka qaban ibsaniiru.

title: FIFA’s Infantino gets Giuliani backing in World Cup selloff fallout
english: Andrew Giuliani has publicly defended FIFA President Gianni Infantino following backlash over a controversial proposal to sell a stake in the World Cup to private investors. Although Infantino later abandoned the plan, he has faced significant opposition from several major football confederations regarding his upcoming re-election. Giuliani dismissed the criticism as politically motivated jealousy, arguing that Infantino has successfully elevated the organization during his tenure.
amharic: የፊፋ የዓለም ዋንጫ ግብይት እቅድን ተከትሎ ከፍተኛ ትችት የገጠማቸው የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ በአንድሪው ጁሊያኒ ድጋፍ ተቸረላቸው። ኢንፋንቲኖ የዓለም ዋንጫን ድርሻ ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ ያቀረቡትን ሀሳብ ቢተውም፣ ይህ ውሳኔ በመጪው ምርጫ ለድጋፍ እንቅፋት ሆኖባቸዋል። ጁሊያኒ ይህንን ተቃውሞ በፖለቲካዊ ቅናት የመነጨ ነው በማለት ኢንፋንቲኖ ድርጅቱን ወደ ተሻለ ደረጃ አድርሰዋል ሲሉ ተከላክለዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin FIFA Giyaanii Infantiinoo, qooda Waancaa Addunyaa invastara dhuunfaatti gurguruuf karoorfachuun isaanii mormii cimaa erga isaan mudatee booda, Andreew Juuliyaaniin deggaramaniiru. Infantiinoon karoora kana erga haaqanii booda, mormiin kun filannoo isaanii kan dhufu irratti dhiibbaa uumuu isaa kan dubbatamu yoo ta'u, gamtaaleen kubbaa miilaa gurguddoon hedduun isaan mormaniiru. Juuliyaaniin, mormiin kun guddina Infantiinoo irratti kan xiyyeeffate fi hinaaffaa siyaasaan kan dhufe akka ta'e dubbatu.

title: A Syrian intervention in Lebanon would be too costly for Damascus
english: The United States has suggested that Syria should intervene in Lebanon to disarm Hezbollah, primarily as a way to pressure Iran. However, Syria is unlikely to take this military action because it would risk triggering Iranian retaliation and destabilizing its own fragile recovery. Ultimately, Damascus views such an operation as too dangerous and costly, preferring to focus on its own internal economic and security stability instead.
amharic: አሜሪካ ሶሪያ በሊባኖስ የሚገኘውን ሂዝቦላህን ትጥቅ እንድታስፈታ ግፊት እያደረገች ነው። ይሁን እንጂ ሶሪያ ይህንን ወታደራዊ እርምጃ የመውሰድ ዕድሏ አነስተኛ ነው፤ ምክንያቱም በኢራን በኩል ሊመጣ የሚችለውን የበቀል እርምጃ እና የአገሪቱን የውስጥ መረጋጋት የሚያናጋ ስጋት በመኖሩ ነው። ዳማስከስ እንዲህ ዓይነቱን ዘመቻ አደገኛ እና ዋጋ የሚያስከፍል አድርጋ ስለምትመለከተው፣ በራሷ ኢኮኖሚያዊ እና የፀጥታ ጉዳዮች ላይ ማተኮር ትመርጣለች።
oromo: Amerikaan siriyaatti fayyadamuun harka Hezbollah kan Libaanoos keessatti argamu akka hiiksisu dhiibbaa gochaa jirti. Haa ta'u malee, siriyaatti tarkaanfii waraanaa akkanaa fudhachuun carraan isaa xiqqaa dha; sababni isaas kun deebii Iran fi tasgabbii biyyattii irratti balaa waan fiduuf dha. Damasqoon tarkaanfii akkanaa kun baay'ee balaa kan qabu fi kan ishee miidhu waan ta'eef, fuulleffannaa ishee haala diinagdee fi nageenya biyya ishee irratti taasifachuu wayya jettee amanti.

title: Israeli strike kills seven in south Lebanon as attacks intensify
english: An Israeli airstrike in southern Lebanon resulted in seven deaths and three injuries after hitting a house near Ansar. This incident marks the most lethal attack in the region since a reduction in hostilities was established in June. Military actions have recently intensified across multiple Lebanese towns, threatening the stability of the fragile framework agreement currently in place.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በአንሳር አካባቢ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት ሰባት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ሦስት ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት በሰኔ ወር ከተደረሰው የግጭት ቅነሳ ስምምነት ወዲህ በክልሉ እጅግ ገዳይ የሆነው ክስተት ሆኖ ተመዝግቧል። አሁን ላይ በበርካታ የሊባኖስ ከተሞች ላይ የሚካሄደው ወታደራዊ ጥቃት እየተባባሰ መምጣቱ በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለውን ስስ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት አደጋ ላይ ጥሎታል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el gammoojjii Kibba Libaanoos, naannoo Ansaaritti haleellaa qilleensaa geggeesseen namoonni torba ajjeeffamanii sadìi ammoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun, ji'a Waxabajjii irraa jalqabee waldhabdee hir'isuuf waliigalteen erga mallatta'ee booda kan sadarkaa ol'aanaa qabu dha. Humni Israa'el magaaloolee Libaanoos hedduu irratti haleellaa isaa cimaa waan jiruuf, waliigaltee nageenyaa jiru sun rakkoo keessa galee jira.

title: Moment Israeli forces storm wedding hall in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli military forces recently conducted a raid on a wedding venue located in the West Bank town of al-Eizariya. According to reports from the Palestinian news agency WAFA, the soldiers physically attacked guests who were attending the celebration. Video footage of the incident shows the military disrupting the event while music was still playing inside the hall.
